name: Yoshitome Miharu
source:
Miharu is a second-year at Kazekoshi Girls' High School and one of [url=/c35501]Kana's[/url] closest friends. Miharu is a serious but fun loving girl. She is close with Kana and seems to be the most worried for her, especially during the individuals. She is sensitive about her flat chest.

Also a fun fact: her voice actress, Chiro Kanzaki, is a professional mahjong player in real life.
